summary: Ships Runtime Foundation E7 (A-C) as dormant backup/restore infrastructure: recovery-payload preparation/validation, backup-v3 payload classification, offline TTS/native restore via E3/E4, safe archive extraction, and stage-95 recovery-receipt acceptance. Corrects two Foundation E validation defects and a staged-restore DB-isolation gap. No canonical runtime provisioned/activated, no TTS caller migrated, no production payload or nightly backup-v3 policy enabled by installing this release.
